verdict.rationale: MailerSend claims email can be 'set up in minutes' and offers official libraries for multiple languages plus a send endpoint, so the core of a fast path to a first email is asserted. No quickstart content is evidenced, and one community report of an unexplained account denial hints at onboarding friction, though it is a single anecdote. Missing for 10: a documented copy-paste quickstart per language, disclosure of required setup steps (e.g. domain/sender verification), and independent hands-on timing from signup to first delivered email.

support.subject: As a developer, I can go from signup to my first delivered email in minutes — the quickstart is copy-paste complete for my language and doesn't hide required setup

citations.quote: Transactional email, WhatsApp and SMS you can set up in minutes and deliver in seconds.
